venue.name: Gillette Stadium
venue.source_note: Coordinates and IANA timezone from the public Greerre NFL stadium dataset; current NFL venue names, team assignments and roof classifications checked against the current NFL stadium list. Retractable and partial roofs are conservatively treated as weather-exposed because game-time roof state is not included.

policy.notes: UNVERIFIED project baseline used only where no venue-specific public procedure was sourced: assume an 8-mile lightning trigger and 30-minute quiet period. This is not an official universal NFL or NCAA rule. NCAA safety guidance is venue-specific and is recorded separately; validate each venue procedure before operational use.

weather.source: SPC HREF CT thunder + NWS regional thunder proxy + HRRR point context
notes: NWS thunder probability is a regional forecast proxy; it is not calibrated to venue policy radii.

quality.message: HREF/NWS thunder probabilities are regional proxies. Local MRMS lightning grids are unavailable; displayed venue-delay odds are experimental and uncalibrated.
